statements.text: The U.S.-China competition in the frontier AI race has major national security implications since frontier AI models can pose significant risks to critical infrastructure, military, economic, and technology domains.
statements.context: NSA release on China-based AI companies’ distillation of U.S. frontier models.

attribution.speaker: National Security Agency (NSA)
attribution.note: NSA release describing a joint NSA, FBI, and CISA advisory. No personal director endorsement is inferred.
